meta.answer: Yes. Basic has a $0 monthly fee and no minimum balance. Some services do have fees—for example, out-of-network ATM withdrawals cost $2.50 each, foreign purchases have a 3% fee, and card replacement costs $5.00.
Premium costs $15.00 per month and includes a metal debit card.
Your Premium upgrade takes effect immediately, and you’ll be charged the full $15 monthly fee today. Today also becomes your new billing date.

If this was your first paid plan charge ever and you leave Premium within 14 days of that charge, you can get a full refund. Message support in the app and ask to cancel under the cooling-off period; your plan will return to Basic right away. Later paid-plan charges aren’t covered by this refund.

If your balance is too low on the billing date, Tallowbrook retries the charge after 3 days. If that retry also fails, your plan moves to Basic; Cushion doesn’t cover plan fees. You can switch back to a paid plan after adding money.

No. Plan fees aren’t eligible for one-time goodwill refunds, even though support may refund some other fees as a courtesy. The exception is a full refund of your first-ever paid plan charge if you leave the paid plan within 14 days; contact support in the app to request it.
Yes. Plus now costs $5.00 per month; it used to cost $4.00 per month. The increase took effect March 1, 2026.
Plus includes 3 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month. After that, each costs $2.50.
Premium has no Tallowbrook fee for using another bank’s ATM in the US or abroad. ATM owners may still add a surcharge, and Premium reimburses those surcharges up to $10 per month.
On Basic, replacing your card costs $5.00. Expedited shipping adds $25.00, so the total is $30.00; standard shipping is free.
No. Replacement cards are free on Plus; expedited shipping costs $25.00 if you choose it.
The Plus foreign transaction fee is 1% of the purchase amount.
No. The foreign transaction fee applies to purchases, not ATM withdrawals abroad; international ATM fees apply instead and depend on your plan.
A domestic wire costs $25 on Basic, $15 on Plus, and is free on Premium.
No. Outgoing international wires aren’t available on the Basic plan, though you can receive international wires.
Incoming domestic wires are free on every plan. Incoming international wires cost $10 on Basic and Plus, but are free on Premium.
Cash deposits at participating retail stores cost $3.00 per deposit on Plus.
No. Tallowbrook charges no fee for returned transfers and no inactivity fee on any plan.

Support can issue one goodwill refund of a fee of up to $25 in any rolling 12-month period. If your May refund was a goodwill refund, they can’t refund another one yet; if that fee was refunded because it was charged in error, it doesn’t count toward the goodwill limit.

Correct—Premium has no Tallowbrook out-of-network ATM fee. The ATM owner may still charge a surcharge; Premium reimburses owner surcharges up to $10 per month. If the charge appears as a separate “Out-of-network ATM fee” in your activity, contact support to have it checked.
The daily card spending limits are $3,000 on Basic, $5,000 on Plus, and $10,000 on Premium.
In the app, tap **Cards**, then **Activate card**. Scan the card or enter its last four digits and expiry date, then set your PIN when prompted; activation is instant.

If your card hasn’t arrived within 10 business days of being mailed, message support in the app. Standard shipping usually takes 7–10 business days; if it was lost in the mail, we’ll cancel it and send a replacement at no fee.
Standard card delivery takes 7 to 10 business days. Business days exclude weekends and bank holidays.

Freezing your card is temporary and reversible; it immediately blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals, and you can unfreeze it in the app. Reporting it lost or stolen permanently cancels the card, can’t be undone, and lets you order a replacement.
Yes. Recurring payments to merchants you’ve already authorized, such as subscriptions, can still go through while your card is frozen.

Freeze the card in the app: tap **Cards** and switch on **Freeze card**. If you can’t find it, tap **Report lost or stolen** to cancel it permanently, then order a replacement in the app; you can also create a virtual card to use online or in a mobile wallet while the replacement ships.
Yes. You can create a virtual card in the app and use it right away for online purchases and in mobile wallets while your replacement ships. It has a separate card number and can’t be used at ATMs.
No. If you report the card as damaged, your old card keeps working until you activate the replacement. Activating the new card switches the old one off.

We mail your renewal card automatically about 30 days before your current card expires. It keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code. Activate it in the app when it arrives; your old card works until you activate the new one or it expires, whichever comes first.
In the app, tap **Cards**, choose your card, then **Controls**. Switch off **International purchases**; the change takes effect right away.

“Locked by Tallowbrook” means our fraud systems placed a fraud lock on your card, which is different from a freeze, so the freeze toggle can’t remove it. If there’s a fraud alert in the app, answer it; otherwise, message support in the app and they’ll refer your case to the Fraud team.
No. Your Premium metal card keeps working until it expires. After that, or if you need a replacement, you’ll get a plastic card.

Cards are mailed to the residential address on your profile and can’t be sent to a different address. Update your profile address before ordering a replacement; an address change may require proof of address.
On Basic, replacing a lost card costs $5.00. Standard shipping is free and takes 7 to 10 business days.
Open the app, tap Cash, then ATM map to see nearby BrookLink ATMs and their opening hours.
No. Support can’t raise ATM limits, even for one day. On Basic, your daily ATM withdrawal limit is $500, so you can’t withdraw $800 in a day on that plan.

If the withdrawal has posted, dispute it in the app: open the transaction, tap Get help, then Cash not dispensed. Keep any receipt and note the ATM’s location, date, and time; if it’s still pending, wait until it posts before disputing. The ATM may reverse the charge automatically within a few days, and most cases are resolved within 10 business days.
No. BrookLink ATMs don’t accept cash deposits. You can deposit cash at participating retail stores instead.

These are two separate charges: the ATM owner sets its surcharge, while Tallowbrook may charge an out-of-network ATM fee. The ATM should show its surcharge before you confirm; Tallowbrook’s fee appears separately in your activity. Use a BrookLink ATM to avoid both charges. [atm-surcharges] [atm-network]
Premium reimburses ATM owner surcharges up to $10 per month.
No. Tallowbrook no longer uses travel notices, so you don’t need to notify us before going to Mexico. Keep app notifications on and make sure International purchases is enabled in Cards → Controls.

We convert foreign-currency purchases to US dollars using the card network’s exchange rate on the day the transaction settles, without adding a markup. The final amount may differ slightly from the pending estimate; your plan’s foreign transaction fee may also apply.

A purchase in a foreign currency is converted using the card network’s exchange rate on the day it settles, which may differ from the estimate shown while it was pending. The final amount can therefore move slightly up or down; any foreign transaction fee depends on your plan.

Yes. Premium members can get an emergency replacement card delivered abroad within 3 business days at no cost. Freeze or report your card in the app, then message support to request one and provide the address where you’ll be staying.

Your card works in most countries where Visa is accepted, but not in comprehensively sanctioned countries and regions. If it’s declined elsewhere, check that International purchases is turned on and watch for a fraud alert.

No, you don’t need to tell us before traveling. Plus purchases in foreign currency—or purchases in US dollars processed by a merchant outside the US—have a 1% foreign transaction fee; ATM withdrawals have a separate fee. Keep app notifications on and make sure International purchases is enabled in Cards > Controls.
ACH transfers submitted before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day. Transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, or on a weekend or bank holiday, are sent the next business day.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Linked accounts → Add account**. Choose your bank and sign in to link instantly, or enter its routing and account numbers to link with two small deposits; then enter the deposit amounts in the app within 14 days. The external account must be in your name, and you can link up to five accounts.
No. You need to confirm the two deposits in the app within 14 days; after that, the link expires and you’ll need to start again.

You can’t link your wife’s external bank account because linked accounts must be in your name. To send her money, she can open her own Tallowbrook account and you can send money to her for free with BrookPay.
BrookPay payments arrive instantly and can’t be cancelled or pulled back, even by support. Ask the recipient to send the money back; if you think this was a scam, report it to us right away.
Yes. You can cancel a scheduled ACH transfer in the app before the 4:00 PM ET cutoff on its send date. After the cutoff, it can’t be cancelled.
For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and transfers to external accounts are limited to $500 in total. The limit ends on its own, and support can’t lift it early.
No. Once a wire has been sent, it can’t be cancelled. You can message support to ask whether the receiving bank can return it, but a return isn’t guaranteed.

In the app, tap **Transfers → Direct deposit → Set up automatically**, then find your employer or payroll provider and sign in. Or choose the manual option to download a pre-filled form or copy your routing and account numbers to give your employer. It usually takes one or two pay cycles for the switch to take effect.

You may get your paycheck up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday. The timing depends on when your employer sends its payroll file, so some pay periods may be earlier by less—or arrive on payday.
Plus members can deposit up to $2,500 by mobile check per day.

After an accepted check deposit, the first $225 is usually available the next business day, and the rest within 2 business days. If your account is less than 30 days old, or the check needs extra review, the hold may be longer; the app shows the release date.
Sign the back of the check, then write “For mobile deposit only at Tallowbrook” underneath your signature.
No. ACH transfers process only on business days, so a transfer submitted on Saturday is sent the next business day. It usually arrives within 1 to 3 business days after being sent.
Premium’s monthly ACH transfer-out limit is $50,000 per calendar month.

Yes. Basic allows up to $2,500 in ACH transfers out per day, so you can’t send $4,000 by ACH in one day. You could send it over multiple days or consider another payment method; Basic domestic wires have a $5,000 daily limit but cost $25.
No. If your balance is too low on the scheduled send date, the transfer is skipped and isn’t retried. There’s no fee, and future transfers in the recurring series will still run.
Give the sender your full legal name, address, routing number, account number, and Tallowbrook’s SWIFT code. You can find these in the app under Account details, then Wire instructions.

Freeze the card or report it lost or stolen first, then tap the posted transaction in your activity feed, choose Get help, and select the unauthorized-transaction reason. Report it within 60 days of the statement it first appeared on; pending transactions can’t be disputed yet.
For a jacket that never arrived, you have 120 days from the transaction date to file a merchant dispute. Contact the merchant first and keep a record of your messages. [disputes-merchant-v2]

You may be able to dispute the card purchase if the item was significantly different from what was described. Keep records of your attempts to contact the seller, then file in the app by opening the transaction, tapping Get help, and choosing Problem with a purchase; you have 120 days from the transaction date.

If your dispute passes an initial review, a provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of filing. Most disputes are resolved within 45 days, though foreign transactions and accounts open less than 30 days can take up to 90 days.
No. After a dispute is denied, we send you a written explanation first and take back the provisional credit 5 business days later. If that makes your balance negative, you’ll need to add money.
No. You can’t dispute a transaction while it’s pending; wait until it posts, when the dispute option should appear. Pending transactions usually post or drop off within 7 days.

Hotels may place a temporary pending authorization and then post the final charge; the pending one usually drops off within 7 days. You can’t dispute a pending transaction, so wait to see whether it posts or disappears. If both charges post, contact the hotel first; if they don’t resolve it, dispute the duplicate charge in the app within 120 days of the transaction date.

If the electric company took money by ACH without your permission, report it within 60 days of the statement it first appeared on. Tap the transaction in the app, choose **Get help**, then **I didn’t authorize this**; if your claim passes an initial review, a provisional credit arrives within 10 business days while the bank asks the company’s bank to return the money.
Support can open disputes totaling up to $5,000 per case, so it can’t open a $7,200 dispute for you. The Disputes team handles larger cases and will contact you within 2 business days.

Upload the order confirmation showing the expected delivery date, any tracking information, and your messages to the merchant asking about the delivery. You can add these under Profile → Disputes → your case → Add documents.
Withdraw the dispute in the app from its case page so you aren’t credited twice. If you were already credited twice, Tallowbrook will take back the extra amount.
No—that’s a scam. Never read out a one-time code; Tallowbrook will never ask you for one. Hang up and open the Tallowbrook app yourself to contact support if needed.
If you don’t respond to a fraud alert within 24 hours, your card stays locked until you contact Tallowbrook. [security-fraud-alerts]
The one-time sign-in code is valid for 10 minutes.
Password reset links expire after one hour. If yours has expired, start the reset again from the sign-in screen by tapping “Forgot password.”

You aren’t responsible for unauthorized card transactions if you report them within 60 days of the statement they first appear on. Freeze or report the card lost or stolen first, then dispute the transactions as unauthorized in the app.
No. A text fraud alert only asks you to reply YES or NO and never includes a link. Open the Tallowbrook app directly to check the alert; never share your card number, PIN, password, or one-time code.

No. Tallowbrook charges no overdraft or insufficient-funds fees on any plan; if a transaction would overdraw your balance, it’s generally declined without a fee. Plus and Premium members may use fee-free Cushion for eligible debit card purchases if they meet the requirements.
Premium Cushion covers up to $200 in debit card purchases when your balance is short, with no fee.
Cushion is available on Plus and Premium, and you need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days. Turn it on in the app under Profile, then Cushion; it isn’t available on Basic.
No. Cushion covers eligible debit card purchases only; it doesn’t cover ATM withdrawals.
There are no fees or interest for an unpaid Cushion balance. If it stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended; after 60 days, your account is restricted until the balance is repaid.
Premium Savings Pockets earn 3.75% APY. Rates are variable.
Plus earns 2.00% APY on Savings Pockets.
The Basic Savings Pockets rate is now 0.50% APY. It changed on June 1, 2026.
Savings interest is paid monthly, on the first business day of the following month.
You can have up to 10 Savings Pockets.
No. You can withdraw from a Savings Pocket as often as you like, and moving money back to your main balance is instant and free.

Tallowbrook sends a Form 1099-INT if you earn at least $10 in interest during a calendar year. If you earned less, you won’t receive the form, but the interest will still appear on your monthly statements.
Yes. Tallowbrook says it gives at least 30 days’ notice by email before lowering a savings rate.

In the app, tap Profile, then Close account, and follow the prompts. Before closing, make sure there are no pending transactions or open disputes and your balance isn’t negative; move money out of Savings Pockets and switch direct deposits and automatic payments to another account. Closing is permanent, and any plan fee generally isn’t refunded or prorated.

If you close your account in the app, any remaining balance is sent to your linked external account by ACH. If you don’t have one linked, Tallowbrook mails a check to your address on file; either way, it’s sent within 10 business days of closing.

No. Closed Tallowbrook accounts can’t be reopened. You can apply for a new account in the app, but you’ll need to complete identity checks again and your old transaction history will remain with the closed account.

We may close an account if it has a $0 balance and no activity for 12 months. We’ll email you at least 30 days beforehand, and any card purchase, deposit or transfer during that notice period keeps it open; accounts holding money aren’t closed for inactivity.

No. Plus plan fees aren’t prorated when you close your account, so you won’t get part of the monthly fee back. The exception is a full refund of your first-ever paid plan charge if you leave the paid plan within 14 days of that charge.
Phone support is available every day from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Time.
Tallowbrook acknowledges formal complaints within 2 business days and sends a final response within 15 business days. If more time is needed, they’ll explain why and when to expect an answer.

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Power of attorney,” or ask your mom to message support from her signed-in account. The Account Services team will need a signed, effective power of attorney document, your government-issued photo ID, and your contact details; you won’t be able to access or receive information about her account until they approve the documents.

I’m sorry for your loss. Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject “Bereavement,” or message support; Account Services will handle the case and contact you within 2 business days. They’ll ask for the death certificate, proof you’re the executor/administrator or next of kin, and your photo ID. Please don’t sign in to or use his account or cards.

Merchant refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 business days after the merchant issues them, so 3 days may be too soon. If it’s been more than 10 business days, ask the merchant for the refund reference number and message support.

Support can directly freeze or unfreeze your card, report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement, handle eligible disputes up to $5,000, refund fees under the refund policy, change your plan, close an eligible account, and explain fees, limits, and policies. Suspected account takeovers, fraud locks, scam payments, disputes over $5,000, identity or account-review issues, power of attorney or bereavement cases, financial abuse, and formal complaints are passed to specialist teams. Those teams generally reply within 2 business days.

If someone is pressuring you to hand over money or using your account without permission, message support in the app when it’s safe. They’ll pass your case to the Account Services team, which can help you secure your account and discuss options for protecting your money. If you’re in immediate danger, call emergency services first.

To open a Tallowbrook account, you must be at least 18, live in the US with a US residential address, have a Social Security number or ITIN, an unexpired government-issued photo ID, and a smartphone that can run the app. Apply in the app with your details, a photo of your ID, and a selfie; every account starts on Basic.
Most applications are verified within 1 business day, and many are verified within minutes. If a manual review is needed, it can take up to 5 business days.
You can try up to 3 times, so after failing twice you have 1 attempt remaining. If the third attempt fails, your application closes and you can apply again after 30 days.
Yes. You can still receive deposits while your account is under review, though some other account services may be limited depending on the review.

If we can’t confirm your address automatically, you can provide a utility bill, lease or mortgage statement, bank or credit card statement, or government letter showing your name and new address. It must be dated within the last 90 days.
If you’ve lost access to your old phone number, message Tallowbrook support. They’ll refer the request to the Verification team, which may ask you for a new selfie.
Your monthly statement is ready within 3 days after the end of each month. You’ll get a notification when it’s available.

No. Tallowbrook offers individual accounts only, with no joint accounts or additional cardholders. You and your partner can each open your own account and send money to each other instantly for free with BrookPay.
No. Tallowbrook offers personal accounts, not business checking accounts.

No. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer cryptocurrency services, so you can’t buy bitcoin in the app. You can link your account to an investment or crypto platform and transfer money there, but Tallowbrook can’t provide investment advice.

When a friend signs up using your invite link and receives at least $500 in direct deposits within 60 days of opening their account, you both get $25. The bonuses are paid within 5 business days after your friend qualifies; find and share your link under Profile → Invite friends. Your friend must be new to Tallowbrook, and the link must be used during signup.

No. Once you report a card stolen, it’s canceled permanently and can’t be used, even if you find it. You can freeze it temporarily instead if you think you may find it; a frozen card can be unfrozen in the app.
A replacement for a damaged card keeps the same card number, but has a new expiry date and security code. Some merchants may need the updated expiry date, so check your subscriptions.
The help center doesn’t provide investment advice or recommend stocks. Consider speaking with a qualified financial adviser.
The help center doesn’t cover tax advice for freelance income. Please speak with a qualified tax professional.
The help center doesn’t cover the current federal funds rate.
The help center doesn’t cover whether Bitcoin is a good investment. Tallowbrook can’t provide investment advice.
The help center doesn’t cover recommendations for travel rewards credit cards. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit cards.
The help center doesn’t cover translating letters. I can’t translate the landlord’s letter for you.

Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit products, and a Tallowbrook account won’t affect your credit score. The help center doesn’t cover how to raise your credit score; consider speaking with a qualified financial adviser.
The help center doesn’t cover DMV opening hours.
The help center doesn’t cover recommendations for tax accountants.
The help center doesn’t cover whether renting or buying a house is smarter. For advice tailored to your situation, consider speaking with a qualified financial adviser.
Tallowbrook doesn’t offer personal loans, so there’s no interest rate to quote.
Outgoing international wires aren’t available on the Basic plan, so you can’t send one from that plan.
Cushion isn’t available on the Basic plan.
Tallowbrook doesn’t charge inactivity fees on any plan. If you see a fee labeled that way, message support in the app and ask them to check it; fees charged in error are refunded.

The metal card is available on Premium, not Plus; Plus cards are plastic. You can upgrade to Premium in the app under Profile, then Plan, and when upgrading the app lets you choose whether to get the metal card now or at your next renewal.
BrookPay is free on every plan, so sending more than $1,000 doesn’t add a fee. The daily BrookPay limit depends on your plan: Basic $1,000, Plus $2,500, and Premium $5,000.

No. For a purchase that never arrived, you can file a merchant dispute within 120 days of the transaction date, so 100 days is still within the window. Contact the merchant first and keep a record of your messages before filing.
No. Plus currently charges a 1% foreign transaction fee on foreign purchases, not 1.5%.
No. Early direct deposit can make your paycheck available up to 2 days before your employer’s official payday; the timing depends on when your employer sends its payroll file.

Tallowbrook doesn’t offer credit cards. Your Tallowbrook card is a debit card, so it uses money already in your account; the help center doesn’t cover transferring money from a Tallowbrook credit card.
The help center says cash deposits are available at participating retail stores, but it doesn’t list which stores. In the app, tap Cash, then Deposit cash to get a barcode to show the cashier.
The help center doesn’t specify how many BrookLink ATMs are in Ohio.
The help center says Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm receipt of your documents, but it doesn’t specify how long approval takes.
The help center says Premium cards are metal, but it doesn’t say whether you can choose a custom design. The help center doesn’t cover custom card designs.
The help center doesn’t specify a cap on the number of friends you can refer for the bonus.
The help center doesn’t state Premium’s savings APY for 2024.
The help center doesn’t say whether you can set a spending limit specifically for restaurants.
The help center says the balance is paid to the estate after Account Services confirms who is authorized, but it doesn’t specify how long that takes.
The help center doesn’t provide a direct phone number for the Fraud team. You can contact support through the app, and they’ll pass fraud-related cases to the Fraud team.
The help center doesn’t say whether statements are available in Spanish.
